The Crystal Caves? True enough, getting in isn't easy because of the Facetteleon, but you have bigger worries. Before you get in you need to get there and sentient trees will rip you to bits if you're not careful. Sure, you can try to fight them, but “trying” isn't the same as “succeeding” now is it? It's best to just avoid them and I know how, which I guess is why you're here. I use a magic charm to get past them, but I only have one and I need it for my work.
Now, if you were to get me a Potion of Bedevilment from the priestess' hut... Drinking that gives me temporary abilities that can be permanently transferred into an item, so I could make a new charm for myself. Oh ho, I know that look! Sure, you could kill me, but then how would you know which item here was the charm or how to use it, hmmm? Nope, I think you'll either have to try to fight your way or get me that potion, what do you say?
